relationships.subject: ibuprofen lysine
relationships.evidence_quote: Assessing the mean pain score within 15 hours of receiving misoprostol showed significantly lower pain intensity within the first 10 hours of assessment in the group receiving NSAID compared to the control group

relationships.subject: ibuprofen lysine
relationships.evidence_quote: The rate of bleeding was also significantly lower in the NSAID group at the fifth (P = 0.013) and ninth (P = 0.040) hour of receiving misoprostol compared to the control group

relationships.subject: NSAIDs
relationships.evidence_quote: NSAIDs can effectively inhibit the biosynthesis of prostaglandins through blocking some special enzymes including cyclooxygenase enzymes (COX-1 or COX-2).

key_findings: Ibuprofen lysine reduced pain for 10 h and bleeding at hours 5 and 9 in first-trimester medical abortion, with no difference in complications.
